table structure operations in the canoni.note: A tracked deletion of a table with a vertical merge gives the default engine's tables once resolved; pending cell text inside a deletion counts as the cell's text.
Deleting the row a vertical merge starts hands the merge and its words to the next row.
Accepting a suggested deletion of the row a vertical merge starts hands the merged cell and its words to the next row.
Deleting the row a vertical merge starts, addressed through another cell of that row, puts the caret in the merged cell the next row takes over.

cell merges, splits and column changes i.note: Rejecting a suggested split of a vertical merge restores the merge, as the default engine's rejection does.
